why: v0.15.0 proved the complete 24s audible captioned showreel export, but the blocking slowdown was still discovered from raw logs and manual investigation. Before adding more authoring or generation power, export needs a product-visible diagnosis surface that shows where time is spent and which spans are slow.

constraints.no_vanity: Visible effect = after export, PM can see a 24s performance map with slow spans and top timing numbers instead of reading raw recorder logs.
constraints.no_overreach: This version only adds export diagnostics data, CLI verification, shell status/report plumbing, and inspector performance map UI. It does not add cloud export, new component syntax, new TTS generation, or broad editor redesign.
constraints.no_rush: The diagnostics schema, CLI help, UI state, and verification evidence must be stable enough for future versions to rely on.
constraints.must_verify: Acceptance = export showreel-24s with diagnostics enabled, inspect the JSON report, see the inspector performance map, and confirm normal export still succeeds with audio/subtitles.

success_picture: User exports showreel-24s and sees export succeeded plus a 24s performance map. Slow regions are highlighted, top slow frames/spans are listed, and the report path can be inspected by AI tools.
risks: Recorder timing data may be too coarse unless frame capture and encode timing are separated enough for useful diagnosis.
Inspector UI can become noisy if it shows every frame instead of grouped slow spans.
Diagnostics must not slow draft export enough to create a new performance regression.

candidates.title: Export diagnostics and performance map
candidates.why: Direct continuation from v0.15.0 blocker. It makes future slowdowns product-visible and AI-verifiable.
candidates.constraints_check: Visible, one version, testable by CLI and screenshot, no unrelated feature work.

candidates.why: Important for future component growth, but it should come after export observability so new components cannot hide performance regressions.
candidates.constraints_check: Visible only indirectly unless paired with new component UI; defer.

candidates.title: Make online editing truly usable
candidates.why: Strong PM-facing value, but it expands editor interaction surface before export diagnosis is reliable.
candidates.constraints_check: Too broad for the immediate post-stability bottleneck; defer.

candidates.why: High product value, but it increases audio/subtitle/render complexity and should ride on diagnostics.
candidates.constraints_check: Would combine generation and export risks; defer.
